why_included: Free public atrium with movable tables, free Wi-Fi, food counter; many laptop users. Limited seating; busy Thursday free performances.
curation_note: duplicate of Rubenstein Atrium

name: PAC NYC lobby (Perelman Performing Arts Center)
why_included: Lobby free and open to public 8am-11pm daily with restaurant/bar; suggested by locals as a work spot. Laptop policy unconfirmed.

name: Whole Foods Market Union Square (upstairs seating)
why_included: Large upstairs dining area overlooking the park; people work for hours. Customer seating: receipts may be checked when busy.

name: Whole Foods Market Tribeca (upstairs cafe)
why_included: Upstairs cafe open 7am-10pm with some outlets and quiet north-window seats; can be loud. Buy a snack.

name: Barnes & Noble Union Square Cafe
why_included: NYU News (Mar 2025): gigantic tables, wall outlets, free Wi-Fi; no purchase required. Good for group projects.

name: Capital One Cafe Union Square
why_included: Free to sit, no purchase required; most outlets of any spot in NYU's list, free Wi-Fi, multiple floors, booths. Crowded Sundays.
curation_note: duplicate of Capital One Cafe Union Square

name: The Center for Fiction Cafe
why_included: Public bookstore cafe-bar: four 8-seat community tables, Wi-Fi with purchase (3h limit), few outlets, can be noisy. Group-friendly.
curation_note: duplicate of Center for Fiction (Fort Greene)
